summary: Northern Trust is a respected institutional custodian and asset manager serving corporations, institutions, and affluent families since 1889. $18.7T AUC/A, $1.8T AUM ($355B in liquidity). Distinctive sustainability-linked digital strategy: Carbon Ecosystem (digital carbon credits), Project Acacia (Australia DvP), Project Guardian (Singapore green bonds). Matrix Zenith proprietary digital platform. Tokenized MMF via BNY/GS DAP (March 2026). Goals Driven Wealth Management for UHNW/HNW. Strong service culture and risk management reputation.
